# Claude Code CLI Flags

A flag changes how one `claude` run behaves.
`claude --help` lists 66 flags, and 64 more are hidden (see [CLI Hidden Flags](Claude-Code-CLI-Hidden-Flags)).
For example, `claude -p "Summarize README.md" --output-format json --max-budget-usd 1` prints one answer and stops, and `claude --model opus --effort high --permission-mode plan` starts a careful planning session.

## About the Table

A row has the mark ✅ when [CLI Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/cli-reference) or another docs page names the flag.
The text of each row says in plain words what the flag does.
For the full behavior, open the docs page.

| Flag | Mark | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-h, --help` | ✅ | Shows the help text and exits. |
| `-d, --debug [filter]` | ✅ | Turns on debug logs, and an optional filter picks the categories. |
| `--debug-file <path>` | ✅ | Writes the debug logs to a file and turns on debug mode. |
| `--verbose` | ✅ | Overrides the verbose setting of your config. |
| `-p, --print` | ✅ | Prints the answer and exits, which suits pipes, and the trust dialog is skipped in this mode. |
| `--bare` | ✅ | Starts with a minimal setup: no hooks, no plugin sync, no auto memory, and no background work. |
| `--safe-mode` | ✅ | Starts with all customizations off, such as `CLAUDE.md`, skills, plugins, hooks, and MCP servers. |
| `--output-format <format>` | ✅ | Sets the output of print mode to `text`, `json`, or `stream-json`. |
| `--json-schema <schema>` | ✅ | Checks the final answer against a JSON Schema. |
| `--include-hook-events` | ✅ | Adds the hook events to the stream, with `--output-format=stream-json`. |
| `--include-partial-messages` | ✅ | Adds partial message chunks to the stream, with `--print` and `stream-json`. |
| `--forward-subagent-text` | ✅ | Adds the text of subagents to the stream as `assistant` and `user` messages, with `--print` and `stream-json`. |
| `--input-format <format>` | ✅ | Sets the input of print mode to `text` or `stream-json`. |
| `--dangerously-skip-permissions` | ✅ | Skips all permission checks, and you should use it only in a sandbox with no internet access. |
| `--allow-dangerously-skip-permissions` | ✅ | Makes skipping all permission checks a choice, without turning it on. |
| `--max-budget-usd <amount>` | ✅ | Stops at a spend limit in dollars, with `--print` only. |
| `--replay-user-messages` | ✅ | Sends the user messages from stdin back on stdout as an acknowledgment. |
| `--prompt-suggestions [value]` | ✅ | Turns on prompt suggestions, and print mode sends a `prompt_suggestion` message after each turn. |
| `--allowedTools, --allowed-tools <tools...>` | ✅ | Lists the tools that run without a permission prompt. |
| `--tools <tools...>` | ✅ | Lists the built-in tools that the model can use. |
| `--restricted` | ✅ | Removes the tools that run code and `WebFetch`, and ignores user, project, and local settings. |
| `--disallowedTools, --disallowed-tools <tools...>` | ✅ | Lists the tools that the model cannot use. |
| `--mcp-config <configs...>` | ✅ | Loads MCP servers from JSON files or strings. |
| `--permission-prompts <target>` | ✅ | Sets who answers permission prompts: `host` or `none`. |
| `--system-prompt <prompt>` | ✅ | Replaces the system prompt for the session. |
| `--append-system-prompt <prompt>` | ✅ | Adds text to the end of the default system prompt. |
| `--system-prompt-snapshot <on\|off>` | ✅ | Sets whether the system prompt is recorded once and reused on every request and resume. |
| `--exclude-dynamic-system-prompt-sections` | ✅ | Moves the data of the machine from the system prompt to the first user message for better cache reuse. |
| `--permission-mode <mode>` | ✅ | Sets the permission mode of the session. |
| `-c, --continue` | ✅ | Continues the newest conversation of the current folder. |
| `-r, --resume [value]` | ✅ | Resumes a conversation by session ID, or opens the picker. |
| `--fork-session` | ✅ | Creates a new session ID when you resume, with `--resume` or `--continue`. |
| `--from-pr [value]` | ✅ | Resumes a session that links to a pull request. |
| `--no-session-persistence` | ✅ | Saves nothing to disk, so the session cannot be resumed, with `--print` only. |
| `--model <model>` | ✅ | Sets the model with an alias such as `opus` or with a full name. |
| `--effort <level>` | ✅ | Sets the effort level of the session. |
| `--agent <agent>` | ✅ | Sets the agent of the session and overrides the `agent` setting. |
| `--betas <betas...>` | ✅ | Adds beta headers to API requests, for API key users only. |
| `--fallback-model <model>` | ✅ | Sets one or more models to try when the main model is overloaded or not available. |
| `--settings <file-or-json>` | ✅ | Loads more settings from a JSON file or a JSON string. |
| `--add-dir <directories...>` | ✅ | Gives the tools access to more folders. |
| `--ide` | ✅ | Connects to the IDE at startup when exactly one valid IDE is open. |
| `--desktop` | ✅ | Opens the session in the Claude Desktop app instead of the terminal. |
| `--strict-mcp-config` | ✅ | Uses only the MCP servers from `--mcp-config`. |
| `--session-id <uuid>` | ✅ | Uses a UUID that you give as the session ID. |
| `-n, --name <name>` | ✅ | Sets the display name of the session. |
| `--agents <json-or-file>` | ✅ | Defines custom agents with JSON or a file. |
| `--setting-sources <sources>` | ✅ | Chooses which setting sources load: `user`, `project`, and `local`. |
| `--plugin-dir <path>` | ✅ | Loads a plugin from a folder or a `.zip` file for this session only. |
| `--plugin-url <url>` | ✅ | Fetches a plugin `.zip` file from a URL for this session only. |
| `--disable-slash-commands` | ✅ | Turns off all skills. |
| `--chrome` | ✅ | Turns on the Claude in Chrome integration. |
| `--no-chrome` | ✅ | Turns off the Claude in Chrome integration. |
| `-w, --worktree [name]` | ✅ | Creates a new git worktree for the session. |
| `--tmux` | ✅ | Creates a tmux session for the worktree, and it needs `--worktree`. |
| `--autocompact <auto\|tokens>` | ✅ | Sets the auto-compact window to `auto` or to 100k to 1M tokens. |
| `--bg, --background` | ✅ | Starts the session in the background and prints its ID. |
| `--brief` | 🔍 | Turns on the `SendUserMessage` tool so the agent can message the user. |
| `--ax-screen-reader` | ✅ | Draws flat text with no borders or animations, for screen readers. |
| `--teleport [session]` | ✅ | Resumes a teleport session. |
| `--cloud [description\|session_id\|url]` | ✅ | Creates a cloud session, or attaches to one by session ID or `claude.ai/code` URL. |
| `--environment <environment_id>` | ✅ | Creates a cloud session on a self-hosted environment. |
| `--remote-control [name]` | ✅ | Starts an interactive session with Remote Control turned on. |
| `--file <specs...>` | 🔍 | Downloads file resources at startup, in the form `file_id:relative_path`. |
| `--remote-control-session-name-prefix <prefix>` | ✅ | Sets the prefix of the names that Remote Control makes, and the default is the host name. |
| `-v, --version` | ✅ | Prints the version number. |
